job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Madison, Florida investment consulting RFP, not the SBCERS global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria have no percentage weights and do not support the four requested categories.
quotes: The Board of Trustees for the City of Madison Police Officer’s & Firefighters’ Retirement System (the “Board”) is soliciting Requests for Proposals (RFP) for Investment Consulting firms
Evaluation consideration will include, but not be limited to, the following:
1. Responsiveness of the Proposal in clearly stating an understanding of the work to be performed.
2. Technical ability of the Proposer(s) and consultant assigned to the case to perform consulting services.
3. Experience of Proposer(s) and assigned consultant.
4. The fees and expenses are a significant factor.
